info.title: Alex API
info.description:
A FastAPI project for golf data
    
    ## Authentication
    
    This API uses API key authentication.
    
    To access protected endpoints:
    
    1. Include your API key in the X-API-Key header of your requests: `X-API-Key: your-api-key`
